keyPhrases.text: a pleasure it most assuredly is
Not since Hairspray has a musical pulled off this duality so well
dancers who are able to burn up the stage with unbridled energy and skill
aimed with great precision at low-hanging fruit
Categorize it as a guilty pleasure, if you wish

reasoning: Strong positive review with minor reservations. Opens with superlative praise ('bonbon of the highest order', 'deliciously entertaining') and explicit endorsement ('a pleasure it most assuredly is'). Acknowledges flaws like being 'manipulative' and targeting 'low-hanging fruit' but frames these as minor issues that don't detract from overall enjoyment. Favorable comparison to Hairspray indicates high praise. Falls in 4/5 star range - enthusiastic recommendation despite some quibbles.
